Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::recommendBook(uid: String,callNo: String,title: String,edition: String,author: String,publisher: String,description: String,isbn: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		uid: String,
		callNo: String,
		title: String,
		edition: String,
		author: String,
		publisher: String,
		description: String,
		isbn: String
	precondition:
		let user: User = User.allInstance()->any(o|o.UserID = uid),book: Book = Book.allInstance()->any(b|b.CallNo = callNo and
		b.Title = title and
		b.Edition = edition and
		b.Author = author and
		b.Publisher = publisher and
		b.Description = description and
		b.ISBn = isbn) in
		User.allInstance()->includes(user) and
		Book.allInstance()->includes(book) and
		user.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		book.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let user: User = User.allInstance()->any(o|o.UserID = uid) in
		let rec: RecommendBook in
		rec.oclIsNew() and
		RecommendBook.allInstance()->includes(rec) and
		rec.RecommendUser = user
}
